ValidationRule.description: Input the Reason Lost and Sub Reason when the parent oppty stage is changed to Closed Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost'), RecordType.Name = 'Parent Opportunity', OR( ISPICKVAL( Reason_Lost_Opp__c ,""), ISPICKVAL( Sub_Reason_Opp__c ,"") ), !$User.Bypass_VR__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the Reason Lost and Sub Reason for this Closed Lost Opportunity
